task_text: Wash lettuce, clear ottoman, store CD, fill the bathtub

central_instructions.R3: Receive the lettuce from R1 and wash it; also receive objects from R2 and store them appropriately.
central_instructions.R4: Fill the bathtub in the bathroom.
